Definition: from G5259 and G5562; to vacate down, i.e. retire quietly:--go aside, withdraw self.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypochōréō carries the sense of to go aside, to withdraw quietly. In Luke 9:10, the text says "and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hypochōréō means to go aside, to withdraw quietly, nothing more and nothing less.
